templates.title: Continuwuity
templates.name: continuwuity
templates.description: Continuwuity v26.7.2 is a community-driven Matrix homeserver and the continuation of conduwuit.

env.name: CONTINUWUITY_SERVER_NAME
env.label: CONTINUWUITY_SERVER_NAME
env.description: Matrix server name. Cannot be changed after the first start without wiping the database.

env.name: CONTINUWUITY_DATABASE_PATH
env.label: CONTINUWUITY_DATABASE_PATH
env.description: Database directory. Must match the data volume mount.

env.name: CONTINUWUITY_ADDRESS
env.label: CONTINUWUITY_ADDRESS
env.description: Bind address. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces inside the container.

env.name: CONTINUWUITY_PORT
env.label: CONTINUWUITY_PORT
env.description: Port Continuwuity listens on inside the container.

env.name: CONTINUWUITY_ALLOW_FEDERATION
env.label: CONTINUWUITY_ALLOW_FEDERATION
env.description: Federation is off until a reverse proxy serves this homeserver over HTTPS.
